summary: Master the essentials of information governance with our comprehensive training. Equip your team to manage data responsibly and uphold regulatory standards.
lede: Information governance training shows professionals how to build a practical framework for managing and protecting organizational information. It is for records and information staff, compliance and risk teams, ICT managers, privacy officers, and others responsible for information. Participants learn to map information assets and flows, assign ownership and accountability, and set classification, access, and retention controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across the public sector, NGOs, and private enterprises who are responsible for managing and securing information.
audience: Compliance, risk, and internal audit professionals
ICT managers and digital transformation leads
modules: Defining Governance Goals, Scope, and Principles
Information Asset and Data Flow Mapping
Access Control, Security, and Privacy by Design
Records Management, Retention, and Defensible Disposal
Governance in Digital Systems and Collaboration Platforms
Governance Monitoring, Audits, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites, but familiarity with information management concepts is beneficial.
